Hi Liam — thanks for the docs, received.

Couple of items from Procurement/Finance side so we can complete onboarding and map the remits cleanly into our AP system:
- Please fill and sign the vendor onboarding form (I attached our standard form) — we need the legal entity name, TAX ID / EIN, and payment contact.
- Finance requires a single "structured remittance string" to be present in the wire's beneficiary reference field. Format we use: "PO:<PO_NUMBER>|INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>|V:GrainTech". Example for your first invoice: "PO:PO-78921|INV:INV-1001|V:GrainTech".
- If your bank supports an ACH addendum/remittance file, we accept a CSV with columns: invoice,amount,PO. Otherwise the beneficiary reference above is sufficient.
- Proof of bank authorization is preferred (bank-signed letter). A notarized letter is not mandatory unless your bank requests it.
- For higher-value first payments we sometimes do a $1.00 test wire; otherwise Finance can verify via micro-deposit. Let us know which you prefer.

Next steps: please return the completed vendor-onboard-form.pdf and confirm which verification you want (micro-deposit or $1/test wire). Once returned, I'll loop in Marissa in Finance to trigger the test and confirm remittance formatting.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
